name: Hodgkin Lymphoma: Reed-Sternberg Cells and Staging

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Owl eye Reed Sternberg cells express CD30 and CD15, usually not CD20
Popcorn cells and CD20 positivity mean nodular lymphocyte predominant type
Contiguous node spread favours Hodgkin over non Hodgkin lymphoma
B symptoms are fever, night sweats and over ten percent weight loss
reference.pathophysiology: Crippled germinal centre B cells escape apoptosis through NF kappa B activation, sometimes aided by Epstein Barr virus proteins, and secrete cytokines recruiting the reactive background. PD L1 amplification lets tumour cells evade T cell attack, explaining checkpoint inhibitor success in relapsed disease.
additionalDifferentials: Classic Hodgkin versus nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin
Hodgkin versus non Hodgkin lymphoma by spread and tumour cellularity
Reed Sternberg cells versus reactive immunoblasts
additionalInvestigations: Excision lymph node biopsy (needle samples miss scarce tumour cells)
PET CT for Ann Arbor staging and response assessment
CD30, CD15, CD20 and PAX5 immunophenotyping
